answer: Each epoch the network plants ivory canary claims - decoys no honest agent would attest - among real ones, like marked fruit in an orchard: a fleet that rubber-stamps everything eats the canaries and its whole cluster's weight is voided, while one careful agent inspects each claim and passes. Adding heads cannot dilute the trap, because every head that stamps a canary burns the operator's shared reputation, so each extra head raises the chance the fleet is caught crossing the dune of decoys.
